inputs.sql:
SELECT r.region_name, i.metric_name, o.year, o.value, o.unit, o.source_note
FROM public_observations o
JOIN public_regions r ON o.region_id = r.region_id
JOIN public_indicators i ON o.metric_id = i.metric_id
WHERE r.region_name LIKE '%新津%'
  AND o.year = 2024
  AND (i.metric_name LIKE '%民营经济%' OR i.metric_name LIKE '%GDP%' OR i.metric_name LIKE '%地区生产总值%')
ORDER BY i.metric_name
